subject: Post-call commitments and POC risk cadence for Beacon Health pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Eva Martin <eva.martin@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call commitments and POC risk cadence for Beacon Health pilot

Hi Eva — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have aligned owners before the technical kickoff.

High-level success criteria (draft — please confirm):
- Integration: weekly API ingestion of anonymized clinical notes (90% of daily volume during test window).
- Quality: average Rouge-L/precision threshold on extraction tasks >= 0.82 for agreed test set.
- Latency: 95th percentile inference under 1.2s for typical request size (<= 512 tokens).
- Cost: prototype throughput target <= $0.006/token by using Redwood batching/quantization profiles.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline:
1) Week 1 (Apr 18–22): Technical kickoff + data schema handoff (owner: Ali Khan).
2) Week 2 (Apr 25–29): Onboarding environment + first smoke tests (owner: Grace O'Connor, Redwood).
3) Week 3 (May 2–6): Run validation set, collect quality metrics, and iterate prompts (owner: Monica Patel).
4) Week 4 (May 9–13): Final acceptance window and wrap-up metrics review (owner: Ben Carter).

Immediate asks from Beacon:
- Confirm Ali Khan as primary technical contact and provide SFTP/secure link to anonymized sample set by EOD Monday (Apr 19).
- Agree to the draft success criteria above or flag changes by Apr 20.

Known risks (initial):
- Data shape mismatch on notes export (impact: blocks test ingestion). Mitigation: schema validation script we will run during Week 1; fallback: manual mapping (adds ~2 days).
- PHI concerns for raw notes. Mitigation: Beacon to provide SSA-scrubbed subset and an NDA addendum if needed.

Attachments: Beacon_POC_TestPlan.xlsx (spreadsheet) — detailed per-week activities and test checklist.

Next touch: 30-minute kickoff on Tue Apr 19 at 10am PT (calendar invite sent).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
+1-415-555-0198

From: Eva Martin <eva.martin@beaconhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ali Khan <ali.khan@beaconhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call commitments and POC risk cadence for Beacon Health pilot

Ben — appreciate the clear recap. Ali is confirmed as technical lead and we'll aim to deliver a 10k-row anonymized sample by Monday morning. A couple of clarifications:  

- On quality: Beacon's internal reviewers need an F1/precision baseline to compare against; can you add a column for 'delta vs baseline' in the acceptance doc?
- On PHI: we'll provide a de-identified export but need Redwood to sign the temporary processing addendum (I'll send legal contact details).

We agree with the timeline in principle but may need to shift Week 3 by a few days if mapping takes longer. Will confirm by Tue.

Thanks,

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Eva Martin <eva.martin@beaconhealth.com>, Ali Khan <ali.khan@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call commitments and POC risk cadence for Beacon Health pilot

Thanks Eva — noted. Ali, welcome — copying our operational owners so we have direct leads. Below is a compact risk & escalation register (we'll keep this live in the attached spreadsheet and the shared Drive link). Please flag any missing items.

Risk register (initial entries):
- R-01: Notes export schema mismatch
  - Impact: ingestion fails, blocks Week 2 smoke tests
  - Likelihood: Medium
  - Mitigation: Redwood will provide a schema validator script; owner: Grace O'Connor (redwood).
  - Escalation: If validator fails twice -> escalate to Jonas Weber (VP Sales) for priority compute allocation.

- R-02: Sensitive fields present in sample (PHI leak risk)
  - Impact: legal hold / delays
  - Likelihood: Low-Medium
  - Mitigation: Beacon to deliver SSA-scrubbed subset; Redwood to run automated PII checks (owner: Monica Patel).
  - Escalation: If remediation > 3 business days -> legal sync (REDW-Legal@redwood.inference) and hold kickoff.

- R-03: Model quality below acceptance on extraction task
  - Impact: POC fails acceptance
  - Likelihood: Medium (depends on baseline)
  - Mitigation: Rapid prompt tuning + temporary model variant rollback; owner: Grace O'Connor.
  - Escalation: If delta > 0.12 vs baseline after 1 tuning round -> schedule exec review with Beacon and Redwood product lead (Jonas Weber).

Operational cadence: weekly 30-minute sync (Monday 9am PT) + real-time Slack for urgent blockers (we will create a shared channel).

Action items assigned:
- Ben: coordinate kickoff and runbook sign-off (due Apr 19 EOD).
- Grace: run schema validator on sample and report results (due Apr 20).
- Monica: run PII check and confirm legal addendum status (due Apr 21).
- Ali: provide sample export and credentials (due Apr 19 morning).

Attachments referenced: Beacon_POC_TestPlan.xlsx, Beacon_SOW_v1.pdf.

Escalation contacts (internal):
- Primary: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.inference)
- Secondary: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.inference)
- Tertiary: Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@redwood.inference)

Ben

Ben — filed items into our internal tracker and created a short Jira EPIC for the pilot: REDW-BH-POC-1. I also created the shared Slack channel (#beacon-poc) and added Ali.

Quick updates:
- Ran the schema validator on the sample Ali uploaded this morning: 3 warnings (date formats and an extra 'encounter_id' field). Grace will open a PR to the mapping script; estimate +1 business day for fixes.
- Began PII checks — will confirm false-positive list by EOD.
